name: Shortcake
source: She is the protagonists blood-related younger sister.  Her name was Ichigo before the start of the game, the protagonist sometimes calls her Ichigo by mistake.  When she 'evolves' at the end of the game her name is Wedding Cake.  Her hobby is cooking; she hates cockroaches, spiders, and mice; her dream is to marry her brother.
